notes.title: PATCH - 05/MAR/2016 - Version: 1.0.2.16
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/renrF4y.jpg[/IMG]
Version: 1.0.2.16 is now live and contains the following additions and changes.

This patch addresses some small issues and requests people have had for the game and brings a few things in line with the later pixel puzzles titles. New achievements have been included along side a removal function for the crabs, new cleaner puzzle board and a few more needed changes.

Full list of additions and changes:
[olist]
    [*]Hotkey to remove crabs.
    [*]Galley only shows completed images.
    [*]Floating level option buttons aligned to left.
    [*]New cleaner puzzle board.
    [*]Fixed pressed button sprites.
    [*]Launcher puzzle move to menu.
    [*]Darkened sea floor.
    [*]Lower water opacity.
    [*]Piece rotation option in menu.
    [*]Social buttons move to menu.
    [*]Updated level info plaque.
    [*]Updated How To Play menu tab.
    [*]Collect 100 crabs achievement.
    [*]Use ghost achievement.
    [*]Use Location achievement.
    [*]Use rotation achievement.
    [*]Net a crab achievement.
    [*]Remove crabs achievement.
[/olist]
Enjoy!!!
